title: Arctic Launcher
shortDescription: A fast Minecraft launcher for Windows, macOS and Linux. Mod loaders, mods, skins, and playing with friends in one small app.
description: Cross-platform Minecraft launcher written in Rust. Installs releases and mod loaders, manages mods and skins, and has a friends flow. Ships with a website and CLI. Open source with regular releases.
highlights: Mod loaders and mods in one app
